segments.name: Protein biomarker solutions
segments.description: Develops and commercializes ultra-sensitive protein biomarker detection instruments, consumables and services for research laboratories, CROs, academic institutions and biopharmaceutical companies.
segments.evidence: As a result of the acquisition of Akoya, the Company reassessed its operating segments and concluded that the Company continues to operate as one reportable segment as of December 31, 2025.
